narr: July started with an active day, with isolated flash flooding in southern Utah, and isolated microburst winds in northern Utah.
ev: A flood wave around 3 feet or higher passed through Pleasant Creek within Captitol Reef National Park. The flood wave was associated with heavy rainfall in close vicinity to the creek.
lsr: A 3+ FOOT FLOOD WAVE PASSED THROUGH PLEASANT CREEK WITHIN CAPITOL REEF NATIONAL PARK.
